versions.content:
[SWS_LOG_00001]
⌈
Log message logged before the
Logging framework
is able
to process them (e.g. daemon communication is not established) shall be queued.
The queue size is defined by
LogAndTraceInstantiation
.queueSize. If this size
is exceeded the oldest entries shall be discarded.
⌋
(RS_LT_00003, RS_LT_00052)
7.1.2 Shutdown
Note
: after
ara::core::Deinitialize()
is called, the application has to stop us-
ing the logging api. It also means that no futher messages can be logged anymore.
